LIVEKIT_URL.description: The websocket endpoint, handed to the browser alongside a token and passed straight into connect. An address, not a credential.

LIVEKIT_API_KEY.description: LiveKit says generating a token requires the API keys, so it must happen on a backend server and be sent to the frontend. The browser never holds this. Names come from LiveKit's own sample environment file.

LIVEKIT_API_SECRET.description: Signs the per-participant JWT. LiveKit says tokens are signed with the API secret to prevent forgery, which is the whole reason it stays server-side.
